**Daily Devotional**

**May 23**

*20 For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse: 21 Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened. (Romans 1:20-21 KJV)*

Verse 20 above tells us that every person that has ever existed has an intuitive knowledge of God, as His creation and all the things that He has created speak of His existence as well as His divine nature. Everyone even has a knowledge of the Godhead’s existence, so when we stand in judgment before our Creator some day, nobody will be able to say they just didn’t know about God, as He has revealed Himself to all people. The scriptures tell us that the Grace of God has been extended to all people also (Titus 2:11), making salvation available to all that will accept Jesus.

Verse 21 is describing how a person can progressively move away from the intuitive knowledge of God that He gives all people. To keep from falling away from God, we must first glorify God for what He is and has done. We must all be very thankful for what God does for us, and we must keep our thoughts and imaginations on God to keep our faith strong. Only by doing these things can we keep from departing from our faith, and be able to stay in the fellowship that God desires us to be in. After all, the whole reason Jesus came to save us was to bring us back into fellowship with Him and the Father (John 17:3), and we need to keep in the Word of God to truly know Him, and be able to fellowship with Him. Jesus said that if we love Him, we will keep His commandments (John 14:15), so we must follow the lead of the Holy Ghost and keep Jesus as our Lord (Hebrews 5:9), to assure we are not blotted out of the book of life (Revelation 3:5).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
